title: Florezza Font

description:
FLOREZZA – Elegant Decorative Serif Font | OTF Only | Luxury Floral Typography
Introduce timeless elegance to your creative projects with FLOREZZA, a sophisticated decorative serif display font featuring graceful curves, distinctive letterforms, and a romantic vintage-inspired aesthetic.
